dataset_research.note: Questions about a selected dataset are answered by calculation with the platform's own analysis and model services. No data values leave the platform and no number is written by a language model.

levels.about: A quick answer from your own documents, plus a couple of web sources if you allow them.
levels.label: Basic

levels.label: Topic overview

search_providers.description: Free encyclopedia articles, read through the official MediaWiki API. A tertiary source: good for background and definitions; confirm important claims in primary sources.
search_providers.label: Wikipedia (English)

search_providers.description: Free scientific preprints (physics, mathematics, computer science, statistics, biology), read through arXiv's official API; full text from the paper's HTML or PDF. Preprints are not peer reviewed. Not endorsed or supported by arXiv.
search_providers.label: arXiv (preprints)

search_providers.description: General web search through a SearXNG metasearch server that the platform owner runs. Needs PREDICTAI_SEARXNG_URL.
search_providers.label: SearXNG (your own instance)
